title: Paying for drops
summary: Your first drop is free. After that you pay per drop, by size, or buy a season pack.

steps.title: Your first drop is free
steps.body: Your first drop is free, up to 200 Tikkas. Your business page is always free.

steps.title: After that, pay per drop
steps.body: The price depends on how many Tikkas are in the drop. You see it on the publish button before you pay, like "Pay ₦… and publish".

steps.title: Pay by card or bank transfer
steps.body: Tikka uses Paystack, so you can pay by card or bank transfer. Your drop goes live as soon as the payment comes through. Tikka never sees your card number.

steps.title: Season packs
steps.body: A season pack is 3 drops paid at once. Buy one in Payments (on a phone: More, then Payments). Each drop you publish after that uses one, and the button says "Publish with your season pack".

tips: Every payment you've made is listed in Payments.
